name: Pano-NeRF
definition: A method for geometry recovery and HDR novel view synthesis from sparse Low Dynamic Range (LDR) panoramic images. It models the scene using irradiance fields, which treat radiance as both a signal conveying lighting information and a light source illuminating other pixels, thereby increasing observation counts for geometry and leveraging irradiance-radiance attenuation for HDR reconstruction.
summary: Pano-NeRF recovers geometry and HDR novel views from sparse LDR panoramics by modeling irradiance fields to explicitly capture inter-reflections within a volumetric framework.
